label: Koblitz E0 n=13 rho frontier, target block 1/2 — registry completion L0 diagnostic
description: The two preregistered strong-rho references, signed-Frobenius rho, and generic negation rho. Candidate ranking uses the paired minimum of the two common-accounting strong references, fixed before data. This prospectively selected target block has four public targets, one warmup and six balanced measured rounds. Per-child censoring is fixed so the sum of child timeout ceilings is at most 2400s inside the 3,600-second EKS deadline; timeouts are retained and never retried.
